servers.description: Your own Hub. HTTPS only: the credentials below are bearer secrets.

host.description: The host you run the Hub on

basePath.description: Set when the Hub is served under a subpath

info.title: EgressView Hub HTTP API
info.description:
Generated from src/permission-matrix.js, the same object the server enforces, so this cannot describe a route the server does not have or miss one it does.

**This describes the access surface, not the payloads.** Request and response bodies are validated by Zod at the route and by CHECK constraints at rest; they are not described here yet. Regenerate with `npm run docs:openapi`.

sessionCookie.name: egressview_session
sessionCookie.description: Browser session. HttpOnly, and state-changing requests additionally require the CSRF token issued with it.

apiToken.description: An API identity token. Stored only as a hash, so a copy of the database does not yield a usable credential.

agentToken.description: An enrolled agent, prefixed egva_. A separate access class: an agent token cannot reach a route in any other class, and a session cannot reach an agent route.
